label: Health insurance enrollment confirmation
subject: Your Blue Shield Enrollment is Confirmed – Plan Details Inside
body:
Dear Jane Doe,

Your enrollment in the Blue Shield of California BluePPO 80 plan is now confirmed. Please review your coverage details below.

Plan Type: PPO (BluePPO 80)
Coverage: Family
Member ID: BSC9182731
Group Number: 77234
Primary Insured: Jane Doe
Effective Date: April 1, 2026

Your physical insurance cards will be mailed to your address on file within 7–10 business days. In the meantime, you may access your digital ID card and full benefit details through the Blue Shield member portal at member.blueshieldca.com.

With your PPO plan, you have the flexibility to see any licensed provider in or out of network, though in-network care will cost less. Your family deductible is $1,500 and your out-of-pocket maximum is $5,000 per year.

For questions about your coverage, please call member services at 1-888-256-3650, Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM.

Warm regards,
Blue Shield of California Member Services
